metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.exec_msg:
Recent image count (Oct-Nov 2021): 61
Baseline image count (Oct-Nov 2000-2013): 854
North 2021 Rainfall (mm): 61.85
North LTA Rainfall (mm): 46.49
North Relative Anomaly (%): 33.02
South 2021 Rainfall (mm): 116.71
South LTA Rainfall (mm): 156.18
South Relative Anomaly (%): -25.27
Southern relative rainfall anomaly (-25.27%) was less than Northern (33.02%).
A
